Highlights

  • Hacker News reports a backdoor in the official Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace that drops a persistent SSH backdoor across macOS, Linux, and Windows
  • OpenCode v2.2.3–v2.2.5 introduces breaking changes: TUI plugins require OpenTUI 0.8, and managed policy integration.use now covers only integrations with separate actions for MCP, skills, and plugins
  • Wiz reports at least nine AI developer platforms breached this month in a series of agentic attacks leading to LLMJacking at scale

Coding Agents & Assistants

Claude Code

  • Release: v2.1.316 adds CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK to turn off the ultrathink keyword, pooled group budgets for the Claude apps gateway, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LOOPED_CROSS_CERT_DROP to keep cross-certificates, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT for subagent effort levels, managed.policy_mode: layered for merged policies, and guardrail.input_tagging for Bedrock guardrails; deprecates fast mode for Opus 4.8 (removed November 30, 2026); fixes shell commands left running on exit, bash aliases with line breaks, bash scripts stopping after first command with SHELLOPTS exported, PowerShell hooks not blocking on exit code 2, and network requests hanging on corrupted compressed responses.
  • Hot issue: #106167: users report a server-delivered "games" instruction blocks professional development work on commissioned digital board wargame modules, refusing legitimate paid client projects since October 27. (6 comments, 6 👍; +12 in the last 24h)
  • Hot issue: #106037: an issue says scheduled tasks miss custom connector tools for the entire run while built-in connectors load normally; custom connector tools appear only after a follow-up message, a regression of a previously fixed issue. (regression; 2 comments, 1 👍; +3 in the last 24h)
  • News: Hacker News reports a backdoor in the official Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace that drops a persistent SSH backdoor across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

OpenCode

  • Release: v2.2.3–v2.2.5: breaking changes include TUI plugins requiring OpenTUI 0.8 and managed policy integration.use now covering only integrations with separate actions for MCP, skills, and plugins; adds built-in Claude Agent provider using claude auth login, worktree and shell mode shortcuts, percentage compaction buffer ("compaction": { "buffer": "20%" }), persistent desktop terminals surviving restarts, opt-in artifacts with local static-file provider, enabled schedules under opencode serve, guided Claude Agent setup, and quick base branch selection; fixes MCP servers disconnected by large stdio messages, idle locations restarting MCP servers, compaction capping at model context window, LiteLLM errors triggering compaction, reasoning preserved on model switch, plugin cursor styles preserved, and Cursor /login instruction replaced with claude auth login.
  • Hot issue: #60399: users report CLI hangs before sending requests on networks that drop fragmented TLS ClientHello (post-quantum key share), with no session, stream, or error for 120+ seconds; works instantly through VPN. (17 comments, 3 👍; +18 in the last 24h)
  • Hot issue: #60573: users report OpenCode and models not working in Russia without VPN, DPI mitigations from previous comments ineffective, affecting Go Plus subscription. (8 comments, 4 👍; +11 in the last 24h)

Oh My Pi

  • Release: v18.14.1 replaces SentToolDefinitions.inactiveFor(messages, tools) with withInactiveTools(context) which also clears stale inactiveTools; fixes long tool-call intents blocking execution when intent tracing enabled; adds codexAccessPrograms stream option and configureCodexAccessPrograms() to disable automatic Daybreak Blue access_programs request on Codex; adds waitForSibling to RotateCredentialOptions to skip sibling-unblock wait; limits Cursor runs through omp auth-gateway to client's own tools advertised as MCP; fixes native judgment requests sending credentials unredacted, Codex sessions losing responses and retrying when native turn lane refuses live steering, and Cursor models being told file/shell tools unavailable while client runs calls anyway.
